name: ProxyPics API
description:
The ProxyPics API allows you to programatically manage your photo requests inside ProxyPics.

The API exposes REST endpoints that exclusively speak JSON format.

## API Endpoints

Live API: `https://api.proxypics.com/api/v3`

For testing your integration, we have a sandbox environment, it is another instance of ProxyPics platform. All requests created under the sandbox aren't available for anyone to complete them, so we have some tools that will allow you to simulate photos submission, photos approval or rejection.

Sandbox endpoint: `https://sandbox.proxypics.com/api/v3`

Sandbox web app: `https://sandbox-app.proxypics.com`

## Authentication

Every request to ProxyPics API is authenticated with an API Key.

You can generate an API Key by going to your Profile page, Integrations left tab here: `https://app.proxypics.com/profile`.
In this page you can generate new API Keys as well as configure your webhooks.

You can pass the API Key either in a header property called `x-api-key` or by the query parameter `api_key`.

## Testing your integration

As said before we have a sandbox instance of ProxyPics platform running on `https://sandbox-app.proxypics.com`.

To start testing your integration create an account at https://sandbox-app.proxypics.com, setup an API Key and start integrating against the sandbox endpoint (`https://sandbox.proxypics.com`).

In order to successfuly create requests, you'll need to add a credit card. You can use the number `4111 1111 1111 1111` with any CVV and a future expiration date.

## Pagination

Every collection endpoints are paginated. The resources are returned inside a `data` key and the pagination meta data is returned inside the `meta.pagination` object.

Example:
```json
{
  "data": { "...": "..." },
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "total": 45,
      "current_page": 1,
      "per_page": 10
    }
  }
}
```

## Content-Type

All requests made to the API should have the Content-Type equals to `application/json`.

## Errors

Errors will be returned with HTTP codes 400, 401, 404 and 422. The response has an `errors` key with a list of the errors occurred.

Example:
```json
{
  "errors": [ ... ]
}
```

## Event Types

Every time you receive a webhook, there's a "event_name" attribute that identifies the event name.

- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestAdded"` -> Photo request created
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestUnassigned"` -> Photo request unassigned, waiting for a data collector
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestAssigned"` -> Photo request assigned to a Data Collector
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestUploadStarted"` -> DC started to take pictures
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::AppointmentScheduled"` -> Appointment scheduled
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::AwaitingSignatures"` -> Awaiting signatures, 1004D Alternative
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::SignatureCollected"` -> Signature collected, 1004D Alternative
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestCanceled"` -> Photo request canceled
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestCompleted"` -> Photo request completed, still waiting for review.
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestExpired"` -> Photo request expired, rarely happens
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestOnHold"` -> Photo request put on hold
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PaymentProcessing::PhotoRequestCostUpdated"` -> Fee updated
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestReportGenerated"` -> Sent with the “fulfilled” status, the report is ready to be downloaded
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestResumed"` -> Removed from hold
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::WebAppOpened"` -> Web App opened by the POC, Direct orders
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PocTextMessageSent"` -> Text message sent to the POC, Direct orders
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestTemplateChanged"` -> When the template is changed in the order
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::PhotoDelivery::PhotoRequestExpirationChanged"` -> When expiration time of the order is changed
- `"ProxyPicsEvents::Messaging::MessageAdded"` -> Message added to an order by the ProxyPics team
